Would you be open to a short kickoff focused on your first priority use case and its data-access constraints?

compliance.redacted_text: Your phone-based ChatGPT system needs lower STT/TTS latency without disrupting its existing proprietary call flow. I’d start by mapping the current pipeline and capturing end-to-end and per-stage timings, then target the dominant delays with small, reversible changes and compare results against the baseline across representative queries. I’ve profiled a phone-based voice assistant where median time to first audio was 2.9 seconds, using timestamps across 500 recorded calls to locate the time spent in each stage. [cs-02] For your system, I’d first check whether latency comes from end-of-speech detection, transcription, LLM response generation, synthesis, or handoffs between services. Then I’d optimize the relevant component while preserving the current providers and deployment architecture, and verify the end-to-end change before proposing broader updates. I won’t assume Django, Lambda, or LangChain are in the critical path; I’d work with what your system actually uses. Could you share the current STT/TTS providers and a redacted call-flow or timing trace so I can identify the best first optimization?

proposal: Getting this voice assistant under two seconds means optimizing the entire audio-to-transcription-to-LLM-to-speech path, not just selecting fast models. I’d build the prototype with Whisper, an LLM, TTS, and a FastAPI WebSocket service, instrument timestamps across each stage, then profile audio processing and model calls to find the largest bottlenecks. I’d treat the latency goal as a measured target rather than promise it before establishing a baseline, and share a stage-by-stage breakdown with optimization tradeoffs. For the health-tech context, I’d first clarify audio retention and access requirements, then design the agreed data-handling controls into the prototype. Relevant work includes profiling a phone-based assistant pipeline across 500 recorded calls, with a subsequent review reporting that the wait before the assistant speaks was cut in half. I’ve also used Whisper to transcribe recorded lessons and built a chat widget that streams answers over WebSockets. My rate is $55/hour. Would you be available to align on the audio-data handling requirements and the latency measurement baseline before implementation?
